name: tidas-link
description: Standalone TIDAS Link profile for supply-chain PCF and selected LCIA data exchange.

scripts.validate:schema: npx --yes ajv-cli validate --spec=draft7 -s schemas/tidas_link_pcf_v0_1.json -d examples/battery-cell-pcf-v0-1.json --strict=false && npx --yes ajv-cli validate --spec=draft7 -s schemas/tidas_link_lcia_extension_v0_1.json -d examples/battery-cell-lcia-extension-v0-1.json --strict=false
scripts.validate: npm run validate:json && npm run validate:schema
